zh.summary: 根据四个连续水深读数的顺序，判断鱼探仪应报告上升、下降、深度不变，还是没有鱼。
topics: 严格递增：每个读数都比前一个大，例如 2、4、5、9；相等不算增加。
严格递减：每个读数都比前一个小，例如 9、7、4、1。
连续比较：只要四个读数中有一对不符合方向，整个序列就不是严格单调的。
steps: 读取四个水深数值 a、b、c、d。
检查 a < b < c < d。如果成立，四次读数都严格上升，输出 Fish Rising。
否则检查 a > b > c > d。如果成立，输出 Fish Diving；再检查四个数是否全部相等，如果相等就输出 Fish At Constant Depth。
如果以上条件都不成立，至少有一处方向改变或相邻数值相等，输出 No Fish。
zh.example: 读数 1、10、12、13 满足 1 < 10、10 < 12、12 < 13，因此每一步都变大，输出 Fish Rising。
zh.correctness: 严格递增判断同时要求第一数小于第二数、第二数小于第三数、第三数小于第四数，所以它恰好识别题目定义的上升序列。严格递减判断以同样方式检查每一步都变小；相等判断要求四个值全部相同。若三种情况都不成立，读数就属于题目定义的 No Fish。
zh.complexity: 只比较四个读数中的固定几对，因此运行时间是 O(1)。O(1) 表示读数的大小不会增加比较次数。额外空间也是 O(1)，因为程序只保存四个整数。
pitfalls: 上升和下降必须是严格的；例如 1、2、2、3 不是 Fish Rising。
全部相等时输出 Fish At Constant Depth，注意完整的输出文字。
不要只比较第一个和最后一个；中间任意一步都必须符合相同方向。

en.summary: Use the order of four consecutive depth readings to decide whether the fish-finder reports rising, diving, constant depth, or no fish.
topics: Strictly increasing: every reading is greater than the one before it, such as 2, 4, 5, 9; equality does not count as an increase.
Strictly decreasing: every reading is less than the one before it, such as 9, 7, 4, 1.
Consecutive comparisons: if even one pair does not follow the direction, the whole sequence is not strictly monotone.
steps: Read the four depth values a, b, c, and d.
Check a < b < c < d. If true, all four readings rise strictly, so print Fish Rising.
Otherwise, check a > b > c > d. If true, print Fish Diving. Then check whether all four values are equal; if they are, print Fish At Constant Depth.
If none of these conditions is true, some direction changes or an adjacent pair is equal, so print No Fish.
en.example: The readings 1, 10, 12, 13 satisfy 1 < 10, 10 < 12, and 12 < 13. Every step increases, so the output is Fish Rising.
en.correctness: The strictly increasing check requires the first value to be less than the second, the second less than the third, and the third less than the fourth. That is exactly the rising rule in the statement. The decreasing check similarly requires every step to get smaller, while the constant check requires all four values to match. If none applies, the readings meet the definition of No Fish.
en.complexity: The program compares only a fixed number of pairs among four readings, so the running time is O(1). O(1) means the sizes of the readings do not add more comparisons. Extra space is also O(1), because only four integers are stored.
pitfalls: Rising and diving are strict; for example, 1, 2, 2, 3 is not Fish Rising.
For four equal readings, print Fish At Constant Depth with the complete wording.
Do not compare only the first and last readings; every middle step must follow the same direction.
